teacher_info.about_teacher: I have lived on 4 continents and counting. My passion for learning about other cultures has led me to a career in teaching around the world and I’ve never looked back. Before this, I worked for a small consulting firm that specializes in globally distributed teams in large multinational companies. My job consisted of co-facilitating workshops on concepts of workplace dynamics and cross-cultural communication to those who are unfamiliar with them. There was, of course, a strong pedagogical component. The aspect of my job I enjoyed most was dealing with different cultures in international business.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I have taught classes of all age groups, from absolute beginner to advanced, in general and business English as well as in subjects ranging from art and history to business etiquette. What sets me apart as a teacher is my ability to empathize with my students and really assess their understanding. My classes are engaging and speaking intensive. I was awarded “Best Teacher” at my position in Peru and have always been popular amongst my students. Perhaps my greatest strength in my jobs has always been that I really get to know and form a bond with my students or clients, which I think is one of the most vital skills needed to thrive as a teacher.

exp_info.description: Helped employees (management, engineers, and administration) improve their English so that they could communicate with suppliers, customers, and partners abroad. Omni Remotes, founded by Philips, is a company that designs remote controls, located in Shenzhen’s High-Tech Park. I created original lessons tailored to their needs, from useful words for product descriptions, to email-writing templates, to polite sentence formulations.

I worked at a highly-ranked Education First adult training center in Shenzhen, where I taught seminars and workshops on general and business English to all levels of students. I was popular among my students and would often serve as a resource for them. My focus is on a communicative approach to language learning, with a specific emphasis placed on common sentence structures, expressions, and idioms, and accurate pronunciation and word stresses problematic for Chinese learners.

I earned the school’s Best Teacher Award for teaching students of disparate ages and levels ranging from absolute Beginner (taught in Spanish) to Advanced (conducted entirely in English and focused on nuanced grammar and academic vocabulary). Given students’ careers and trajectories, emphasis was placed largely on academic and professional business English. I created original tests and lesson plans.

In this role, I worked with large multinational clients in various industries, largely in pharmaceutical and healthcare. There was also a strong pedagogical component, I co-facilitated company-created workshops on virtual communication and cross-cultural working and worked extensively with ESL learners.

teacher_info.introduction:
It's great to meet you. I'm Inanna, your specialist in Business and Academic English. Originally from the US, I have also lived in Latin American and Europe and have worked online with students from Asia as well over the last eight years. Most of my students are professionals and MBA/grad or university students who already speak English, but need help to work on professional projects, academic requirements or want to level up quickly in their communication ability and sound more fluent and authentic. 

My focus is on practical results so I really listen to what you need and create the class for you personally each time so that we can work on exactly what you need to do to achieve your goals quickly. The style of the class is personable and fast-paced but relaxed. If you have a special project and need to spend several hours in one week to get it done, I am available to do that also. 

Whether you have a big job interview or meeting coming up, a presentation to give, CV to write or a big test to take, we can work on it together intensively to help you make it the best it can be. For the last year I have been developing a curriculum, textbook and online course for advancing professionals to expand their communication skills quickly.

I began teaching TOEFL students taking their English entrance exams and then moved into teaching English to management in multinationals and global banks. This quickly moved into helping with presentations, conference calls, interviews and MBA school. Having run a few small businesses myself, real world experience is part of our class. 

My specialty is the ability to listen and understand what it is you do exactly and then to help you do it well in English. 

What really motivates me are my wonderful students from all sorts of backgrounds . Though everyone is doing something unique and different, we can always find a way to make it great by really personalizing the process of learning.  

Hope to meet you here soon! ~Inanna

pro_course_detail.title: English Speaking and Conversation Class for Professionals: Phrases, Fluency and Idioms.
pro_course_detail.description:
Tired of textbooks? There's a reason for that. How we speak is something different from just good grammar. Did you know that a well-chosen phrase or idiom can make you sound more fluent? It's entirely possible to take your English from good to great with just a little attention to some new ways to phrase things. This course is especially for those times you want to work on your fluency, your pronunciation and usage, and it addresses both business and social environments. Learning happens in a natural and fun way, so you remember and can put your new knowledge into practice immediately.

The method I use in this class is collaborative. You practice real world conversation in a natural and relaxed way, with instruction and feedback/correction given in an ongoing responsive manner. New knowledge is integrated into the class in response to ongoing assessment. 

What this means is that we have a nice, interesting conversation. While we are chatting, I correct your mistakes in writing, and ask further questions to give you a chance to use your new knowledge. As we speak or as we are learning something, I am always doing assessment- finding the patterns in your speech that you can quickly improve to get better spoken English really fast. Quick grammar reviews are given in real time, only as mistakes are made. This is not a traditional grammar class!

*If you have Upper Intermediate English and would like to improve your English speaking, reading, listening, writing and presenting on issues in your field and other technical or complex topics related to tech, law, energy, AI, blockchain, or engineering, please see my classes “Tech Talk” and “Special Projects”.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English Bootcamp
pro_course_detail.description:
This is the class you need to take to “level up” (to go from so-so to strong English).

We will practice all of the English skills: speaking, writing, listening, reading, and vocabulary. If you would like to focus on specific skills, for example, speaking, we can “place emphasis” (focus on) that topic until you feel confident. 

After your assessment test, I will create a checklist of what you will learn, provide materials for free, and help you fix your mistakes. 

The goal of this class is to help you “get unstuck” (move ahead quickly) and to enjoy and feel confident about using your English in real life.

Depending upon the scale or duration of your task, we may need to meet for only an hour, or you can choose a package for ongoing development, if you need more preparation, speaking or writing practice, or skill development. 

This class is my passion and I so enjoy helping you do your best work.

pro_course_detail.title: English Speaking Practice and Terminology - Tech Talk
pro_course_detail.description:
If you love talking about AI, blockchain, the IoT, Agile, and all things tech, this is the speaking practice for you. 

This class is perfect for those of you who have already attained a high level of English, and simply need to keep practicing in order to sound more natural and keep your skills fresh. 

It is offered in a fluid, relaxed format using an interactive/responsive teaching style. We have a chat like co-workers or friends, and I will bring a discussion topic though either of us can introduce one. We might have a quick reading for reference to facilitate the discussion which may be taken from a tech article or Twitter or the latest news. The goal here is to improve your confidence in speaking by actually doing it in a simulated real-world conversation.

The hour-long class is for a once or twice a week speaking practice and the 30 minute session is perfect for when speaking several times a week for shorter sessions is important but you don’t have much free time.

This is a really fun class for fellow techies!

This class is perfect if you have a strong background, but don’t live in an English speaking country, and just need to practice more. If you need deep grammar work, please look at the Intermediate Bootcamp. If speaking with more confidence is your goal, this class is for you.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginners (English / Français / Deutsch)
pro_course_detail.description:
Willkommen zu deiner ersten Online-Deutschunterrichtsstunde mit mir!
Bienvenue à ton premier cours de français en ligne avec moi !
Welcome to your first online private lesson! 
I'm thrilled to help you begin your journey into the language world that you are pursuing! Whether you're learning for travel, work, or just for fun, we'll start from the very basics to build a strong foundation.
In our lessons, we’ll cover the essentials of the language that you are learning, starting with pronunciation and the alphabet. You’ll learn basic vocabulary and phrases that will allow you to communicate in everyday situations. We’ll also dive into the fundamentals of grammar, like sentence structure and verb conjugation, in a simple and clear way.
Our sessions will be interactive and engaging, with a mix of speaking, listening, reading, and writing activities to make learning enjoyable and effective. I'll also provide you with resources and exercises to practice on your own, helping you make steady progress.
Let’s begin this exciting language-learning adventure together and discover the beauty of speaking your new language!

pro_course_detail.title: Group Lessons for English and French (2-4 students)
pro_course_detail.description:
In a world that is increasingly interconnected, learning a new language is more important than ever. Online group language lessons offer a convenient and flexible way to acquire these skills. Whether you’re a beginner or looking to advance your proficiency, group lessons provide a collaborative environment where learners can thrive.

Interactive Learning: 
- Group lessons encourage interaction between students, enhancing communication skills and providing real-world practice.
-Cost-Effective: Group sessions can be more affordable for students while still allowing the instructor to maintain a profitable rate.
-Diverse Perspectives: Students from different backgrounds bring unique perspectives, enriching the learning experience for everyone.
-Motivation and Support: Learning in a group creates a sense of community, where students can motivate and support each other.

pro_course_detail.title: Sing Your Way to Fluent English 🎶🎸🎷🎺🎹
pro_course_detail.description:
Looking for a fun and effective way to improve your English? My online private lessons are designed to make learning both enjoyable and engaging by incorporating English-language songs into each class!

What to Expect:
Customized Song Selection: We’ll use popular English songs from different genres (based on your preference) to enhance your listening skills, vocabulary, and pronunciation. Songs are a great way to remember words and phrases, helping you learn without even realizing it!

Active Listening & Comprehension: You won’t just listen to music — we’ll dive deep into the lyrics, identifying new vocabulary, expressions, and grammatical structures. You’ll learn how native speakers use the language in real life.

Singing for Pronunciation: Whether you’re a fan of singing or not, using music to practice pronunciation is a fantastic way to get those tricky sounds right. Don't worry if you’re shy — this is all about improving your accent and fluency in a relaxed and safe environment.

Creative Activities: Lessons include exercises like lyric gap-filling, reordering verses, and discussions about song themes. We’ll also explore cultural references and idiomatic expressions that appear in music.

Personalized Feedback: Each session is tailored to your goals, whether you're working on speaking, writing, listening, or reading. You’ll receive specific feedback and resources to keep improving between lessons.

Flexible Scheduling: Classes are scheduled at your convenience. Whether you want regular weekly sessions or a flexible schedule, we'll work it out to suit your needs.

By learning through music, you’ll enjoy the language, develop a natural flow in English, and boost your confidence in no time! Let's make your English learning experience as fun and memorable as your favorite song!

Ready to start? Book a lesson today!
